question: ∆ABC ∼ ∆EDF and area (∆ABC) : area (∆EDF) = 9 :4. If AB = 5 cm, BC = 8 cm and CA = 10 cm, then DF is equal to:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Areas** of similar triangles = Square of the ratio of **Corresponding Sides**.

Area(ΔABC) : Area(ΔEDF) = 9 : 4 ⇒ Ratio of sides = √9 : √4 = 3 : 2.

Since ΔABC ∼ ΔEDF, side **BC** corresponds to side **DF**.

3 units = BC = 8 cm ⇒ 1 unit = 8/3 cm.

2 units = DF = 2 × (8/3) = 16/3 = 5 1/3 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 1/3 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** ΔABC ∼ ΔEDF, AB = 5 cm, BC = 8 cm, AC = 10 cm, Area(ΔABC) : Area(ΔEDF) = 9 : 4.

**Formula:** If Δ1 ∼ Δ2, then Area(Δ1)/Area(Δ2) = (Side1/Side2)².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e32f5940a93af63ce7f9fc10d6d8ee7bfda40e3b1e9af986aee19292434e1bf3.png] 

For similar triangles ΔABC and ΔEDF, the ratio of their areas is equal to the square of the ratio of their **corresponding sides**.

⇒ Area(ΔABC) / Area(ΔEDF) = (BC / DF)²

⇒ 9 / 4 = (8 / DF)²

Taking square root on both sides:

⇒ √(9 / 4) = 8 / DF

⇒ 3 / 2 = 8 / DF

⇒ 3 × DF = 8 × 2

⇒ 3 × DF = 16

⇒ DF = 16 / 3

⇒ DF = 5 1/3 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 5 1/3 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area and Side Ratio Theorem

If two triangles are similar, the ratio of their areas is equal to the square of the ratio of any two corresponding sides, altitudes, medians, or angle bisectors.

Similarity Criteria

Triangles are similar if they satisfy **AA** (Angle-Angle), **SAS** (Side-Angle-Side), or **SSS** (Side-Side-Side) conditions.

Perimeter Ratio

The ratio of the perimeters of two similar triangles is equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides: P1/P2 = s1/s2.</p
